content.content:
/api/dashboards:
    get:
      description: Returns a paginated list of dashboards. Each result includes title, description, tags, and metadata, but not the full panel layout. Use `GET /api/dashboards/{id}` to retrieve the complete state.
      operationId: get-dashboards
      parameters:
        - description: The page of results to return.
          in: query
          name: page
          required: false
          schema:
            default: 1
            minimum: 1
            type: number
        - description: The number of results to return per page.
          in: query
          name: per_page
          required: false
          schema:
            default: 20
            maximum: 1000
            minimum: 1
            type: number
        - description: Filters results by `title` and `description` using Elasticsearch [`simple_query_string`](https://www.elastic.co/docs/reference/query-languages/query-dsl/query-dsl-simple-query-string-query) syntax. Multi-word terms require all words to match.
          in: query
          name: query
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
        - description: A tag ID to include. Accepts a single tag ID or multiple tag IDs. When multiple are specified, library items matching any of the tag IDs are included.
          in: query
          name: tags
          required: false
          schema:
            default: []
            description: Tag IDs associated with this dashboard.
            items:
              maxLength: 250
              type: string
            maxItems: 100
            type: array
        - description: A tag ID to exclude. Accepts a single tag ID or multiple tag IDs. When multiple are specified, library items matching any of the tag IDs are excluded.
          in: query
          name: excluded_tags
          required: false
          schema:
            default: []
            description: Tag IDs associated with this dashboard.
            items:
              maxLength: 250
              type: string
            maxItems: 100
            type: array
        - description: A tag name to include. Accepts a single tag name or multiple tag names. When multiple are specified, library items matching any of the tag names are included. If the same name is shared by multiple tags, items matching any of those tags are included.
          in: query
          name: tag_names
          required: false
          schema:
            items:
              type: string
            maxItems: 100
            type: array
            x-state: Generally available; added in 9.6.0
        - description: A tag name to exclude. Accepts a single tag name or multiple tag names. When multiple are specified, library items matching any of the tag names are excluded. If the same name is shared by multiple tags, items matching any of those tags are excluded.
          in: query
          name: excluded_tag_names
          required: false
          schema:
            items:
              type: string
            maxItems: 100
            type: array
            x-state: Generally available; added in 9.6.0
      responses:
        '200':
          content:
            application/json:
              examples:
                searchDashboardsResponse:
                  description: |
                    Paginated list of dashboard summaries. Each item includes the ID, a subset of dashboard state fields (`title`, `time_range` if set), and metadata. Full panel content is not included - use the GET endpoint to retrieve a specific dashboard.
                  summary: Search dashboards response
                  value:
                    data:
                      - data:
                          title: Web logs overview
                        id: 3c4b8e10-d57a-11ef-9a52-4f3c2a8d0e1b
                        meta:
                          created_at: '2026-04-13T10:00:00.000Z'
                          managed: false
                          updated_at: '2026-04-13T10:00:00.000Z'
                          version: WzEwMiwxXQ==
                      - data:
                          time_range:
                            from: now-7d
                            to: now
                          title: Operations overview
                        id: 7f2a1c40-e83b-11ef-a641-7d5b3f9e1c2a
                        meta:
                          created_at: '2026-04-12T08:00:00.000Z'
                          managed: false
                          updated_at: '2026-04-12T14:22:00.000Z'
                          version: WzEwMSwxXQ==
                    meta:
                      page: 1
                      per_page: 20
                      total: 2
              schema:
                anyOf:
                  - additionalProperties: false
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      data:
                        description: List of dashboards matching the query. Each entry includes summary fields but not the full panel layout.
                        items:
                          additionalProperties: false
                          type: object
                          properties:
                            data:
                              additionalProperties: false
                              type: object
                              properties:
                                access_control:
                                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Kibana_HTTP_APIs_kbn-dashboard-access-control'
                                description:
                                  description: A short description of the dashboard.
                                  type: string
                                tags:
                                  description: Tag IDs associated with this dashboard.
                                  items:
                                    maxLength: 250
                                    type: string
                                  maxItems: 100
                                  type: array
                                time_range:
                                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Kibana_HTTP_APIs_kbn-es-query-server-timeRangeSchema'
                                title:
                                  description: The dashboard title.
                                  type: string
                              required:
                                - title
                            id:
                              description: The dashboard ID.
                              type: string
                            meta:
                              $ref: '#/components/schemas/Kibana_HTTP_APIs_kbn-as-code-meta'
                          required:
                            - id
                            - data
                            - meta
                        maxItems: 1000
                        type: array
                      meta:
                        additionalProperties: false
                        type: object
                        properties:
                          page:
                            default: 1
                            description: The returned page of results.
                            minimum: 1
                            type: number
                          per_page:
                            default: 20
                            description: The number of results returned per page.
                            maximum: 1000
                            minimum: 1
                            type: number
                          total:
                            description: The total number of results matching the query.
                            type: number
                        required:
                          - total
                    required:
                      - data
                      - meta
                  - additionalProperties: false
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      dashboards:
                        description: List of dashboards matching the query. Each entry includes summary fields but not the full panel layout.
                        items:
                          additionalProperties: false
                          type: object
                          properties:
                            data:
                              additionalProperties: false
                              type: object
                              properties:
                                access_control:
                                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Kibana_HTTP_APIs_kbn-dashboard-access-control'
                                description:
                                  description: A short description of the dashboard.
                                  type: string
                                tags:
                                  description: Tag IDs associated with this dashboard.
                                  items:
                                    maxLength: 250
                                    type: string
                                  maxItems: 1000
                                  type: array
                                time_range:
                                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Kibana_HTTP_APIs_kbn-es-query-server-timeRangeSchema'
                                title:
                                  description: The dashboard title.
                                  type: string
                              required:
                                - title
                            id:
                              description: The dashboard ID.
                              type: string
                            meta:
                              $ref: '#/components/schemas/Kibana_HTTP_APIs_kbn-as-code-meta'
                          required:
                            - id
                            - data
                            - meta
                        type: array
                      page:
                        description: The page of results returned.
                        type: number
                      total:
                        description: The total number of dashboards matching the query.
                        type: number
                    required:
                      - dashboards
                      - page
                      - total
          description: success
        '400':
          description: bad request
        '403':
          description: forbidden
        '500':
          description: internal server error
      summary: Search dashboards
      tags:
        - Dashboards
      x-codeSamples:
        - label: Search dashboards - cURL
          lang: cURL
          source: |
            curl -X GET "${KIBANA_URL}/api/dashboards?query=web+logs&per_page=10" \
              -H "Authorization: ApiKey ${API_KEY}"
        - label: Search dashboards - Console
          lang: Console
          source: |
            GET kbn:/api/dashboards?query=web+logs&per_page=10
        - label: Filter by tag name - cURL
          lang: cURL_tag_names
          source: |
            curl -X GET "${KIBANA_URL}/api/dashboards?tag_names=Security&tag_names=Observability" \
              -H "Authorization: ApiKey ${API_KEY}"
        - label: Filter by tag name - Console
          lang: Console_tag_names
          source: |
            GET kbn:/api/dashboards?tag_names=Security&tag_names=Observability
        - label: Exclude by tag name - cURL
          lang: cURL_excluded_tag_names
          source: |
            curl -X GET "${KIBANA_URL}/api/dashboards?excluded_tag_names=Deprecated" \
              -H "Authorization: ApiKey ${API_KEY}"
        - label: Exclude by tag name - Console
          lang: Console_excluded_tag_names
          source: |
            GET kbn:/api/dashboards?excluded_tag_names=Deprecated
      x-state: Generally available; added in 9.5.0
      x-metaTags:
        - content: Kibana
          name: product_name
    post:
      description: Creates a new dashboard and returns its ID, full state, and metadata.
      operationId: post-dashboards
      parameters:
        - description: A required header to protect against CSRF attacks
          in: header
          name: kbn-xsrf
          required: true
          schema:
            example: 'true'
            type: string
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/Kibana_HTTP_APIs_kbn-dashboard-data'

content.text:
I created the dashboard and the alert rule in your local Kibana. The rule's first run succeeded with 0 alerts. I haven't checked that its 5xx query actually matches any documents in the sample data, and I didn't open the dashboard to confirm the panels render.

**1. What the data holds.** The 'Kibana Sample Data Logs' data view has one document per web request, with `timestamp` as the time field. The main fields are:
- **Request:** `response` (HTTP status code, stored as text), `bytes`, `url`, `request`, `extension` and `referer`.
- **Client:** `clientip`, `agent` and `machine.os`.
- **Location:** `geo.src`, `geo.dest` and `geo.coordinates`.
- **Other:** `host`, `tags`, `memory` and `machine.ram`.

**2. Dashboard: "EFF-c7e7051d Web logs overview"** (id `2f52ff6b-7024-4c2c-9f6f-a36b7fde6e90`, default range last 7 days). It has seven panels:
- **Four headline numbers:** total requests, unique visitors (distinct client IPs), average bytes per request, and total bytes served. These are based on the 'Kibana Sample Data Logs' data view.
- **Requests over time by response code:** a stacked bar chart.
- **Top 10 requested URLs:** a horizontal bar chart.
- **Requests by OS:** a bar chart.

The three charts query the `kibana_sample_data_logs` index directly with ES|QL, so they don't use the data view.

**3. Rule: "EFF-c7e7051d 5xx spike"** (id `33c7af66-ca70-4326-84e3-429a3943640f`). It's an Elasticsearch query rule on the data view that runs every minute. It fires when more than 10 requests with a 5xx code arrive in the last 5 minutes. Because `response` is stored as text, it finds 5xx codes with `response.keyword >= 500 and response.keyword < 600`, which compares the codes as text. That works for three-digit codes. The rule has no actions, so when it fires it raises an alert in Kibana but doesn't send any notification.
